title: Chidamide and cytarabine synergistically treat acute myeloid leukemia: inhibiting ribosome biogenesis via the MYC-RRP9 pathway.
authors: Li, Qing; Wang, Fangfang; Xiang, Xinrong; Zhao, Lei; Li, Xuefeng; Qu, Ying; Huang, Jingcao; Yang, Yunfan; Dai, Yang; Shuai, Xiao; Liu, Jiazhuo; Huang, Jie; Liu, Yu; Wu, Yu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物协同治疗白血病，虽含分子对接和MD模拟但聚焦药物-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: This study explores innovative therapeutic approaches for acute myeloid leukemia by examining the synergistic effects of the histone deacetylase inhibitor chidamide in combination with cytarabine. In both in vitro and in vivo models, the drug combination demonstrated significant synergism in combating acute myeloid leukemia. Transcriptomic analysis revealed that the combination treatment notably downregulates the MYC signaling pathway. Binding assays, including surface plasmon resonance, molecular docking, and molecular dynamics simulations, further demonstrated that chidamide directly interacts with the C-MYC protein, while cytarabine enhanced this interaction. Delving deeper into the mechanism, we identified RRP9-an essential gene for ribosome biogenesis and a key player in acute myeloid leukemia prognosis-as a critical component of the MYC pathway. It was confirmed that MYC regulates RRP9 expression. Functional assays showed that overexpression of RRP9 promoted acute myeloid leukemia cell proliferation and resistance to the chidamide-cytarabine combination, whereas RRP9 knockdown impaired rRNA synthesis, reduced nucleolar size, and diminished protein production. Ultimately, we found that chidamide combined with cytarabine effectively inhibit ribosome biogenesis in acute myeloid leukemia cells. These results underscore the therapeutic potential of targeting the MYC-RRP9 axis to disrupt ribosome biogenesis in acute myeloid leukemia, offering a promising avenue for acute myeloid leukemia treatment.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过探讨组蛋白去乙酰化酶抑制剂西达本胺（chidamide）与阿糖胞苷（cytarabine）的协同作用，探索急性髓系白血病（acute myeloid leukemia）的创新治疗策略。在体外和体内模型中，该药物组合在对抗急性髓系白血病方面表现出显著的协同效应。转录组分析揭示，联合治疗显著下调MYC信号通路。结合实验，包括表面等离子体共振（surface plasmon resonance）、分子对接（molecular docking）和分子动力学（molecular dynamics）模拟，进一步证明西达本胺直接与C-MYC蛋白相互作用，而阿糖胞苷增强了这种相互作用。深入机制研究后，我们鉴定出RRP9——一个对核糖体生物发生至关重要的基因，也是急性髓系白血病预后的关键因子——作为MYC通路的关键组成部分。已确认MYC调控RRP9的表达。功能实验显示，RRP9的过表达促进了急性髓系白血病细胞的增殖，并增强了对西达本胺-阿糖胞苷联合治疗的耐药性，而RRP9敲低则损害rRNA合成、减少核仁大小并降低蛋白质生成。最终，我们发现西达本胺联合阿糖胞苷能有效抑制急性髓系白血病细胞中的核糖体生物发生。这些结果强调了靶向MYC-RRP9轴以破坏急性髓系白血病中核糖体生物发生的治疗潜力，为急性髓系白血病治疗提供了有前景的途径。
